spans.text: **If you only have Read tool:** Read 5-10 representative files. Note line counts from the Read tool output (most Read tools report line counts). Extrapolate the average.
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes accurate reconnaissance and honest reporting. It instructs the agent to use actual data from the codebase, verify findings through sampling, and report metrics transparently. The scaling strategy explicitly acknowledges limitations ('This avoids the impossible task of reading 2,000 files during Recon') and instructs extrapolation to be noted.
